title: Kid-friendly Italian Cheese Orecchiette
description: A fun, cheesy pasta dish that kids love. This recipe is easy to make and can be adjusted to suit various dietary needs.

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.notes: whole milk or a non-dairy milk alternative

instructions: Cook the orecchiette pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a saucepan, heat the milk over medium heat until it starts to simmer.
Add the cheddar cheese to the milk and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the mozzarella cheese to the milk and stir until melted and smooth.
Combine the cooked pasta, cheese sauce, and buns in a large serving dish.
Serve the pasta hot with pickle slices on top.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
